clips.title: The story
paras: In the southern Barrens, Lok's Skull marks the fall of a feared Razormane leader. Lok Orcbane led fierce quilboar raids against Horde supply routes, and the skull is his severed head.

Lok Orcbane led aggressive Razormane assaults on Horde supply lines in the southern Barrens. He emerged from Razorfen Kraul with his lieutenants Nak and Kuz. After betraying Mangletooth and leaving him captive at Camp Taurajo, Lok became known to orcish defenders for ruthless raids they struggled to contain. Mangletooth directs Horde champions to Lok's camp, where claiming Lok's skull avenges the captive and strikes at the leadership driving the Razormane offensive.
